title: Highlighted starting rates in the website description
summary: Updated the homepage search, social sharing, and structured-data descriptions to state: Comfort Moving Chicago: Rates start at $135 per hour for two movers and a truck.
impact: Gives prospective customers a clear starting price when previewing the homepage in search results or shared links.

title: Paused new job requests across customer forms
summary: Replaced all 23 customer quote and pickup forms with a notice that Comfort Moving Chicago is not accepting new jobs at this time. Updated the form-card headings and removed unused submission scripts from those pages.
impact: Makes the booking pause clear at every customer lead form and stops those forms from collecting new job requests.
ownerNote: The careers application remains available; this change pauses customer job requests.

title: Reopened customer quote and pickup forms
summary: Removed the booking pause notices and restored all 23 customer quote and pickup forms and their CRM submission scripts.
impact: Customers can once again submit new job requests through the website.
